title: Purchases: none yet
summary: DJDL's Purchases before the first verified purchase: no tabs, toolbar or empty table, just the kit's first-run empty state saying where purchases come from and how to see one now (a test purchase), linking to Storefronts' test-purchase step.
compare: First-run empty state (EXPERIENCE.md §9): an icon in the Commerce tint, 'No purchases yet', one paragraph and one action; tabs, filters, Export CSV and the table appear with the first purchase.
The action goes to the test-purchase step on Storefronts (the one Accept test purchases switch), not to a per-store page.
The page sub-line keeps the refund rule, so it reads the same before and after the first purchase.
Phone: the empty state centres in its card; the button fills the width.
